title: MeedyaManager Settings
description: User-editable configuration for MeedyaManager, matching crates/mm-core/src/config/mod.rs::AppConfig field-for-field (regenerated for issue #211 — see settings_schema_properties_match_appconfig in that module's test suite). (C) 2025-2026 MWBM Partners Ltd

dry_run.description: Whether to run the application in dry-run / preview mode globally

test_mode.description: Test Mode — when enabled, edit/tag operations create _MeedyaManager suffixed copies instead of modifying originals

folders.description: Directories to watch for new/changed media files

poll_interval_secs.description: Polling interval in seconds (used when native FS events are unavailable)

debounce_ms.description: Debounce window in milliseconds — events within this window are merged

include_extensions.description: File extensions to include (empty = all supported media types)

template.description: MusicBee-style template for building the destination file path

output_dir.description: Root output directory where organised files are placed (null = same directory as the source file)

conflict_strategy.description: Strategy when a destination file already exists

create_dirs.description: Whether to create missing directories in the output path

copy_mode.description: Whether to preserve the original file (copy) instead of moving

rules.description: Named rules for conditional template selection (crate::rule_engine::Rule); evaluated in priority order, first match wins. Not modelled field-by-field here — see help/rule-syntax.md.

missing_tag_mode.description: Behaviour when a tag is missing during template evaluation

console.description: Whether to emit logs to the console (stdout/stderr)

file.description: Optional path to a log file (null = no file logging)

max_file_size_bytes.description: Maximum log file size in bytes before rotation (default 10 MB)

max_rotated_files.description: Number of rotated log files to keep

redact_pii.description: Whether to redact personally-identifiable information (PII) in logs

providers.description: Metadata provider settings (API keys, enabled providers, etc.)

discogs_token.description: Discogs personal access token (prefer MM_DISCOGS_TOKEN env var)

spotify_client_id.description: Spotify client ID (prefer MM_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID env var)

spotify_client_secret.description: Spotify client secret (prefer MM_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET env var)

tmdb_api_key.description: TMDb API key (prefer MM_TMDB_API_KEY env var)

acoustid_api_key.description: AcoustID API key (prefer MM_ACOUSTID_API_KEY env var)

request_timeout_secs.description: Global request timeout for provider API calls, in seconds
